trap.label: subject to
trap.why: Em português “sujeito a mudança” e o aluno muda a preposição por of. Em inglês, subject to é fixo.

fix.wrong: The ticket is subject at availability.
fix.right: The ticket is subject to availability.
Plans may be subject to approval.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com subject to: “Prices may change.”
Reescreva com subject to: “If funding exists, we will continue.” (Subject to…)
rewrite.answer: Subject to funding, we will continue.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com modal: “Plans are subject to approval.” (may)
rewrite.answer: Plans may be subject to approval.
